name: Crystallography
boundaries: Crystallography: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal nucleant for any protein or macromolecule
original_dispositions.reason: The claim that this would solve the remaining majority of the proteome was not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: General first-principles crystal-structure prediction for any composition, including inverse design
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by CRX-03 for the unsolved molecular and disordered problem. The any-composition and minutes-scale inorganic claims are partly achieved and were not given a new ID. Property-to-structure inverse design needs further property models and was not added.

original_dispositions.original_title: Atomic-resolution ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins in near-native or cellular states
original_dispositions.reason: Folded structures are already widely available from prediction and cryo-electron microscopy. Full disordered ensembles are primarily a problem for NMR, solution scattering, and integrative modeling. In-cell atomic imaging is primarily cryo-electron tomography. Crystal-based correlated motion remains CRX-04. Single non-crystalline molecules remain CRX-01.

original_dispositions.original_title: Femtosecond-to-picosecond movies of any chemical or enzymatic reaction
original_dispositions.reason: Photo-triggered movies already exist for selected systems, so the entry is limited to the unsolved non-photo-triggered elementary step.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete experimental quantum crystallography of electron density, spin, and bonding
Atomic-resolution structures of non-crystalline and amorphous materials, including glasses, liquids, and polymers
original_dispositions.reason: Liquids are explicitly a further breakthrough inside that entry because a liquid has no single static coordinate list.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal model-free solution of the phase problem for any size, powder, nanocrystal, or twin
original_dispositions.reason: For ordinary crystals, experimental phasing, direct methods, molecular replacement, and predicted models already make structure solution routine. Powders and imperfect nanocrystals remain harder, and three-dimensional electron diffraction plus predicted models now solves many of those samples. The remaining difficulty is an important methods problem. It is not a new capability at the calibration scale. Phase retrieval for continuous single-particle diffraction stays inside CRX-01.

original_dispositions.original_title: In-situ atomic crystallography under arbitrary extreme and operating conditions
original_dispositions.reason: Split by mechanism. One-shot structures of matter that cannot be repeated are CRX-08. Continuous atomic completeness inside working devices and static extreme environments is added as CRX-12. Elementary chemical steps are CRX-06.

original_dispositions.original_title: Predictive elimination of defects, twinning, and disorder during growth
original_dispositions.reason: Added as CRX-13. It is not CRX-07, which selects the polymorph, and it is not a post-growth defect map.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-01 through CRX-10 are retained. None was deleted, replaced, or merged. Titles are unchanged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The underlying historical ideas were compared with the first-pass concepts.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-01 now states the overlap with historical item 7 and excludes in-cell disordered-protein ensembles.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The latter problem is mostly outside crystallography.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-02 now states the overlap with historical item 6 and with CRX-13.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: CRX-13 is about preventing defects during growth.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-03 now records the 2025 rigid-molecule survey, the March 2025 drug-like validation, the September 2026 generative-model benchmark, and Desiraju’s 2026 forecast, and it explicitly refuses the historical claims of any-composition inverse design.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The entry covers the unsolved molecular, disordered, and near-degenerate case.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-04 now separates crystal diffuse ensembles from intrinsically disordered proteins in cells.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Those proteins usually are not crystals, and in-cell imaging is not a crystallographic method.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-05 adds the 2025 IUCr quantum-crystallography collection as evidence of activity, not completion.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The collection does not establish a general quantum-state measurement.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-06 names Schulz and co-authors and marks photo-triggered movies as the achieved portion of historical item 4.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The unsolved scope is the non-photo-triggered elementary step.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-07 names Du, Bae, and De Yoreo.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The notes identify the authors of the non-classical crystallization review.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-08 names Kraus, Preston, and Zastrau.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The notes identify the authors of the warm-dense-matter review.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-09 replaces the unverified neutron crystal-size quotation with the verified Liebschner sentence from the deposited PDF.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The 2024 review's author line remained unverified and direct reload failed.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CRX-11, CRX-12, and CRX-13 are new. They are the historical nucleant, sustained operando and static-extreme, and defect-suppression ideas after the obsolete proteome claim, the one-shot extreme-matter idea, and the polymorph-selection idea were removed from them.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Three historical ideas are not the same capability as the retained first-pass concepts.
